emily_cs: FYI — prepping Solstice QBR. Notable items: token burn +420% MoM on embeddings, onboarding still at 60% (docs complete but no SSO), and they're flagging renewals if costs don't stabilize.
aj_ops: showing the token burn is concentrated on search embeddings endpoint — 3.7M tokens/day last week. Created a quick forecast: next 30d ~ 110M tokens if trend continues.
maria_finance: can you drop the forecast numbers? we need to model discount ask. Also set a budget alert threshold at 70% of committed credits :warning: 
sam_se: quick wins — enable prefix caching + reduce batch size for interactive sessions. Could save ~25% token ops. I'll put a config patch in the playbook.
dong_devx: sharing playbook link: https://redwood.internal/docs/qbr-playbooks/embed-costs — add notes for SSO kickoff and training cadence.
carmen_manager: assign owners — aj_ops for forecast, sam_se for optimization, emily_cs for customer comm. I'll own renewal convo.
emily_cs: thanks. timeline: need a deck draft by Tue EOD. can someone draft the cost slide with before/after numbers?
aj_ops: i'll drop a CSV and a small chart. attaching quick numbers:
```
last_7d_tokens: 25,900,000
proj_30d_base: 77,700,000
proj_30d_trend: 110,000,000
estimated_savings_cache: -27,500,000 (25%)
```
maria_finance: if we assume 25% savings, renewal ask likely reduced to a small retention credit not a price cut. Good leverage.
emily_cs: capture customer feedback items: request for better token visibility in console, clearer onboarding checklist, and an internal SSO quickstart.
sam_se: noted on visibility — I'll add a per-route token breakdown to the Dashboard backlog ticket #789.
alert-bot: Budget alert created for Solstice: threshold=70% of committed credits; triggers to #customer-success and email to carmen_manager.
emily_cs: next steps: sam_se implement quick wins by Friday, aj_ops finalize numbers Mon, emily to draft deck Tue. thanks team :pray:
